notes: Homepage title: 'Vintage Clothing & Dresses – Retro Clothing Styles | Unique Vintage'. About page (og:description): 'Back in 2000, our vintage-loving CEO and Founder, Katie Echeverry, would spend her weekends browsing the local vintage shops in her hometown of Burbank, CA' (founded_year left empty: the page dates the idea, not the company).
kind retailer: first 250 products of the dresses feed are 178 Unique Vintage, 28 Smak Parlour, plus Elle Rebel, Retrolicious, Vintage Vandalizm and others.

Shipping policy: 'Free shipping available for all orders over $130, after discounts and before tax'; warehouse days exclude US holidays. Country selector lists Canada, UK and Australia and there is an international returns link, but no international shipping terms are stated, so ships_to is US only.
Returns page: items postmarked within 30 days of delivery; shipping fees non-refundable; final sale not returnable; free returns and exchanges only with the paid opt-in at checkout.
Sizes: size guide and filters run X-Small to 5X; feed variants include 1X/16 to 5X/26 and 32W-34W.
